title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Judges 16: Samson carries off the gates of Gaza, gives Delilah three false answers, loses his hair and dies with the Philistines.

questions.text: What did Samson carry away at midnight from the city of Gaza?
questions.explanation: He took hold of the doors of the gate of the city with the two posts, plucked them up, bar and all, and carried them up the mountain before Hebron.

answers.text: The doors of the city gate with the two posts
The idol that stood in the Philistine temple
A cart full of plunder taken from the Philistine houses
The bronze altar from the middle of the city

questions.explanation: He loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

questions.text: How much did each lord of the Philistines promise to give Delilah?
questions.explanation: They said, "We will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver."

answers.text: Two hundred shekels of gold and a purple robe

questions.text: What did Samson first say would make him weak if he were bound with them?
questions.explanation: Samson said, "If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then shall I become weak."

answers.text: Fine linen thread from the loom
Seven green cords that were never dried

questions.text: What did Samson do the second time, when Delilah bound him with new ropes?
questions.explanation: Delilah bound him with new ropes, and he broke them off his arms like a thread.

answers.text: He let the Philistines lead him away to Gaza without a fight
He burned them in the fire
He broke them off his arms like a thread

questions.text: What did Samson tell Delilah to weave with the fabric on the loom?
questions.explanation: He said, "If you weave the seven locks of my head with the fabric on the loom."

answers.text: The seven locks of his head
His cloak and the belt he wore around his waist

questions.text: What did Samson finally say would make his strength go from him?
questions.explanation: He said, "No razor has ever come on my head... If I am shaved, then my strength will go from me."

questions.text: What did Samson do in the prison in Gaza after the Philistines put out his eyes?
questions.explanation: They bound him with fetters of bronze, and he ground at the mill in the prison.

answers.text: He guarded the gate of the prison

questions.text: To which god did the lords of the Philistines gather to offer a great sacrifice?
questions.explanation: The lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god.
His brothers and his father's house buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father.
